data.name: Chudasama
data.gender_notes: Chudasama is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Chudasama refers to the mountain where Lord Shiva and Parvati reside. It is believed that the moon god, Chandra, visits this mountain to bathe in the sacred river Ganga. The name Chudasama carries the meaning “Moon's mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chudasama usually hope their child will grow to embody moon's mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner peace, spiritual growth, and the divine presence of Lord Shiva.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chudasama total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

They were known for their business acumen and their charitable contributions to Jain monasteries and temples.
